title: Signed plugin release envelope v1
description: Release metadata plus the exact bytes that were signed. `payloadB64` is carried rather than re-derived so a verifier checks the signer's bytes, not its own reconstruction of them; a disagreement between the payload and the `release` fields is itself an integrity failure.

keyId.description: Signing key. Must be in the trust set; the package never chooses its own verifier key.

release.description: Every field here is inside the signature. Design section 5 requires the signature to bind id, version, platform, digest, size, compatibility range and release serial.

serial.description: Monotonic release serial per plugin. A serial below the accepted one is a replay or an unauthorized downgrade and is refused.

payloadB64.description: The exact canonical payload bytes that were signed, standard base64.
